ratios.quote: On a rolling twelve-month basis, the Total Leverage Ratio, defined as consolidated total indebtedness to consolidated EBITDA, shall not exceed 3.50 to 1.00 (for the twelve months ended September 30, 2026, the Company’s Total Leverage Ratio was 2.22 to 1.00).

On a rolling four-quarter basis, the Senior Secured Leverage Ratio, defined as the ratio of consolidated senior secured net indebtedness to consolidated EBITDA, shall not exceed 3.00 to 1.00 for any fiscal quarter ending on or after September 30, 2024 (for the twelve months ended September 30, 2026, the Company’s Senior Secured Leverage Ratio was 2.21 to 1.00).

On a rolling twelve-month basis, the Interest Coverage Ratio, defined as consolidated EBITDA to cash consolidated interest expense, shall not be less than 3.00 to 1.00 (for the twelve months ended September 30, 2026, the Company’s Interest Coverage Ratio was 5.32 to 1.00).

parsed.notes: Senior Secured Leverage and Interest Coverage covenants apply only while amounts/exposure are outstanding under the revolver or Term Loan A. The Total Net Leverage Ratio (2.21x vs 3.50x) and the Total Leverage Ratio thresholds of 2.50x/2.75x are triggers for restrictions on prepayments and dividends/repurchases, not maintenance covenants, so they are not listed separately. The non-GAAP Net Debt Leverage Ratio (2.19x; 1.57x at 12/31/2025) and its 1.50x-2.00x target are management metrics, not covenants. The company reported compliance with all financial covenants.
